reserves.name: EUR bank deposits and the State Street EUR Liquidity LVNAV Fund

sources.label: Monerium fee schedule and reserve policy

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: financial-information still names safeguarded institutions Arion Bank (Iceland), LHV Bank (Estonia), and State Street Global Advisors (Europe), states policy is to hold only as much in bank deposits as needed for anticipated redemptions, and states that for EURe the bulk of users' funds is safeguarded in the AAA-rated State Street EUR Liquidity LVNAV Fund. Fee-schedule still states e-money tokens are overcollateralized 102% and safeguarded in short, high-quality, and liquid assets (sovereign or corporate bonds) or with banks. No current provider or asset-class weights and no independent assets-and-liabilities composition schedule. Modeled as one full-envelope bank-deposit/LVNAV basket with basket-needs-split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Monerium safeguarding policy; provider and asset-class weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserves fall within the disclosed bank-deposit and State Street EUR Liquidity LVNAV Fund basket, but the current allocation by provider and asset class is not public. Monerium states public attestations are being prepared and does not provide a current independent assets-and-liabilities reconciliation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Monerium names the two banks and State Street fund manager but does not publish provider shares. Segregation, priority claims, creditor exclusion, and the EMI prohibition on lending safeguarded customer funds are explicit; the underlying fund retains its own disclosed portfolio mechanics.
